card.statement:
Let $\mathscr{C}$ be a $\mathbf{k}$ -linear abelian category. Let $P$ be a projective object and let $A=\End_{\mathscr{C}}(P)$. Let $\mathrm{Modfp}_{P}$ be the full subcategory of $\mathscr{C}$ consisting of those objects that admit a presentation of the form $P_{1}\to P_{0}\to M\to 0$, where $P_{1}$ and $P_{0}$ are direct sums of finitely many copies of $P$. Let also $\mathrm{Modfp}^{r}_{A}$ be the category of finitely presented right $A$ -modules.

The functor $G=\Hom_{\mathscr{C}}(P,\bm{?})$ defines an equivalence of categories from $\mathrm{Modfp}_{P}$ to $\mathrm{Modfp}^{r}_{A}$.

The endomorphism ring of the functor $G:\mathrm{Modfp}_{P}\to\mathrm{mod}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is canonically isomorphic to $A^{\mathrm{op}}$.
card.label: Proposition 13.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
